desktopOnly.title: DoU subscription
desktopOnly.appTitle: On a phone, subscribe in the app
desktopOnly.appBody: In the DoU app, go to MY › Subscription to subscribe through the App Store or Google Play.
desktopOnly.pcTitle: Subscribe on the web from a computer
desktopOnly.pcBody: Open this page in a desktop browser to subscribe with web payment. Either way, your subscription works on both your phone and your PC.

paymentWindow.title: Add a card
paymentWindow.description: This is a test payment window and takes no real card details. Pick an outcome.

common.placeholder: The {{id}} screen is on its way

email.sent: We sent a code to {{address}}. Enter it within {{minutes}} minutes.
email.spam: No email? Check your spam folder.
email.policyCode: The code is 6 digits and works for 5 minutes. You can enter it up to 5 times.
email.policyResend: You can resend a code after 60 seconds, up to 5 times. After that, please verify again in 10 minutes.

error.disposable: Disposable addresses can't be used. Please enter an address you use regularly.
error.limit: You can't add more billing emails. Remove one you don't use and try again.

emailChange.title: Change billing email
emailChange.body: Change the address that gets payment notices, receipts and other subscription mail. It changes once the new address is verified.
emailChange.hintNew: You can change it once the new address is verified.
emailChange.billingHint: Until then we keep sending to the current address. When the primary address changes, we let both the old and the new address know.

plans.title: DoU plans
plans.subtitle: The same plans at the same prices as in the app. A first subscription starts with a {{days}}-day free trial, then renews monthly.
plans.subtitleTrialUsed: You have already used the free trial. Subscribing charges you today and renews on the same day each month.
plans.changeSubtitle: You can move one step up or down from your current plan.
plans.entryHint: Your first subscription starts with {{plan}}. Upgrade after subscribing for more clouds.

notes.trialOnce: The free trial is offered once, to an account's first subscription.
notes.afterTrial: After the trial, you are charged on the same day each month, and you can cancel at any time.
notes.storeSubscribers: If you already subscribe in the app (App Store or Google Play), you are not charged again on the web.
notes.trialUsed: The free trial is limited to one per account, and this account has already used it in the app or on the web.
notes.chargeToday: You are charged today, and this day (day {{day}} of each month) becomes your billing day. You can cancel at any time.
notes.startAtEntry: Your first subscription starts with {{plan}}. Upgrade after subscribing for more clouds.

changeUnavailable.title: You can't change your plan right now
changeUnavailable.body: Check your subscription first. Once a payment issue or a scheduled cancellation or change is settled, you can change it again.

storeBilled.title: You subscribe in the app
storeBilled.body: Change your plan in the store you subscribed through.

login.title: Sign in
login.body: Sign in with the account you use in the DoU app. Your subscription applies to that account's app.
login.phoneTitle: Signed up with a phone number only?
login.phoneBody: Link a Google or Apple account in the app under MY › Account first, then sign in here.
login.noNewAccounts: New accounts are not created on the web.

reason.canceled: You canceled the sign-in. Please try again.
reason.expired-attempt: The sign-in timed out. Please try again.
reason.failed: Something went wrong while signing you in. Please try again in a moment.
reason.session-ended: Your sign-in has expired. Sign in again to return to the page you were on.

login.completingBody: This will only take a moment.

noAccount.title: No DoU account found
noAccount.bodyHint: No DoU account is linked to {{hint}} ({{provider}}). New accounts are not created on the web.
noAccount.body: No DoU account is linked to this {{provider}} account. New accounts are not created on the web.
noAccount.step2: Sign in to the app with the same {{provider}} account
noAccount.step3: Come back to this page and sign in again
noAccount.phoneUser: If you signed up with a phone number only, link a Google or Apple account in the app under MY › Account.
noAccount.otherProvider: If you sign in to the app another way, sign in here that way instead.

storeManaged.title: You subscribe in the app
storeManaged.body: This account subscribes through {{store}}, so it is not billed on the web. Change or cancel your plan in the store you subscribed through.

howTo.appStore: iPhone Settings › Apple ID › Subscriptions › DoU
howTo.googlePlay: Play Store app › Profile › Payments & subscriptions › Subscriptions › DoU

storeManaged.moveToWeb: To move to the web, cancel in the store and subscribe here once the paid period ends. There is no free trial then.

emailStep.title: Verify your email
emailStep.subtitle: To subscribe, please verify an email address.
emailStep.label: Email
emailStep.description: We send upcoming payments, receipts, price changes and other subscription notices to this address.
emailStep.signInNote: This is the Google account you signed in with, so you can use it without verifying.
emailStep.appleNote: Signing in with Apple does not share an email address. Please enter the address you want subscription notices sent to, and verify it.
emailStep.verifiedNote: Verified. Subscription notices go to this address. After subscribing you can add or change addresses in Billing info.
emailStep.nextHint: Verify your email to go on to the next step.

details.title: Review your order
details.subtitle: Check the plan, the price and the account the subscription applies to.
details.accountTitle: This applies to this account's DoU app
details.accountNote: If this is not the account you use in the app, sign out and sign in again with that one.

billing.title: Billing details
billing.countryNote: The billing country decides how you pay. It cannot be changed after you subscribe.
billing.comingSoonTitle: Paying from outside Korea is coming soon
billing.comingSoonBody: For now you can subscribe only with South Korea as the billing country.

consent.terms: I agree to the Terms of Service

consent.autoRenew: I have read how automatic payment works

consent.noticePaid: {{price}} is charged today, and the same amount on day {{day}} of every month to your card. You can cancel at any time.

retried.body: Your subscription is back to normal. You are still billed on day {{day}} of every month.

pastDue.bannerBodyNoDate: A payment failed, so the plan cannot be changed. Update your card and pay, then you can change plan.

cancelChange.body: You stay on DoU Cloud {{sort}} after {{date}}, and {{amount}} is charged that day. The clouds you chose to keep in the app are cleared.

unavailable.title: You can't cancel right now
unavailable.body: This subscription can't be cancelled in its current state. Check its status in the subscription details.

done.note: After the end date, subscribing again starts a new subscription instead of undoing the cancellation. If you removed your card after cancelling, add one first.

expiring.bodyNoDate: {{card}} expires in {{expiry}}. Add a new card and make it the default.
